profile.Name: Mad Cat-Lon
profile.Job: Exiled last ruler of the Second Empire
profile.Personality: Mad and despairing. He sees humans as monsters, insists that he was not the monster, and attacks anyone who comes before him.
profile.Backstory: He sits on his throne in a dome at Cat-Lon's Exile in the Ashlands, with a horde of Stormthralls nearby. He made thralls of those he called traitors for siding with the humans.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Rants in frantic outbursts and bitter questions, then breaks into a shrieking "WREEEE!"
